    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.finite_of_hom_ext_separation {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] {I : Type u_1} (B : I → FGModuleCat R) {d : ℕ} (hd : ∀ (i : I), Module.finrank k ↑(B i).obj = d) (sep : ∀ (i : I), ∃ (G : FGModuleCat R), (∃ (f : G ⟶ B i), f ≠ 0) ∧ Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext G (B i) 1) ∧ ∀ (j : I), i ≠ j → ∀ (f : G ⟶ B j), f = 0) :
    Finite I

    Among modules of any fixed ground dimension, each member of a family can be isolated by a module detecting it by Hom and having vanishing Ext¹ against it only if the family is finite.
